verses.arabic: قٓ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ
verses.translation: Qāf.[1524] By the honored Qur’ān...[1525]
verses.footnotes:
[1524]- See footnote to 2:1.
[1525]- See footnote to 38:1.

verses.arabic: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
verses.translation: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.

verses.arabic: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌ
verses.translation: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant [i.e., unlikely] return."

verses.arabic: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ
verses.translation: We know what the earth diminishes [i.e., consumes] of them, and with Us is a retaining record.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular
Active participle — nominative, masculine, singular, indefinite

verses.arabic: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍ مَّرِيجٍ
verses.translation: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.

verses.arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍ
verses.translation: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍ
verses.translation: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,

verses.arabic: تَبْصِرَةً وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيبٍ
verses.translation: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allāh].

verses.arabic: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً مُّبَٰرَكًا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ
verses.translation: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest

verses.arabic: وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَٰتٍ لَّهَا طَلْعٌ نَّضِيدٌ
verses.translation: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -

verses.arabic: رِّزْقًا لِّلْعِبَادِ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ
verses.translation: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the emergence [i.e., resurrection].

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
verses.translation: The people of Noah denied before them,[1526] and the companions of the well[1527] and Thamūd
verses.footnotes:
[1526]- i.e., before the disbelievers of Makkah.
[1527]- See footnote to 25:38.

verses.arabic: وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍ
verses.translation: And ʿAad and Pharaoh and the brothers [i.e., people] of Lot

verses.arabic: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
verses.translation: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.

verses.arabic: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍ مِّنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
verses.translation: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
verses.translation: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer[1528] to him than [his] jugular vein.
verses.footnotes: [1528]- In absolute knowledge of everything about him. "We" has also been interpreted to mean the angels who are mentioned in the following verse.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular

verses.arabic: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌ
verses.translation: When the two receivers [i.e., recording angels] receive,[1529] seated on the right and on the left.
verses.footnotes: [1529]- And record each word and deed.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ
verses.translation: He [i.e., man] utters no word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ
verses.translation: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ
verses.translation: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.arabic: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ
verses.translation: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.[1530]
verses.footnotes: [1530]- i.e., one angel driving the soul to the Judgement and one to testify as to its deeds.

verses.arabic: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ
verses.translation: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover,[1531] so your sight, this Day, is sharp."
verses.footnotes: [1531]- Of heedlessness, or that which had sealed your hearing, your vision and your heart from guidance.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ
verses.translation: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."

verses.arabic: أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ
verses.translation: [Allāh will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,

verses.arabic: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُّرِيبٍ
verses.translation: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
verses.translation: Who made [as equal] with Allāh another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."

verses.arabic: قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
verses.translation: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ
verses.translation: [Allāh] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the threat [i.e., warning].

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 2nd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
verses.translation: The word [i.e., decree] will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍ
verses.translation: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular

verses.arabic: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ
verses.translation: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive

verses.arabic: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍ
verses.translation: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allāh] and keeper [of His covenant].

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, plural, passive
Active participle — genitive, masculine, singular, indefinite

verses.arabic: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُّنِيبٍ
verses.translation: Who feared the Most Merciful in the unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].

verses.arabic: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ
verses.translation: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."

verses.arabic: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ
verses.translation: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
verses.translation: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
verses.translation: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ
verses.translation: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.

verses.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
verses.translation: So be patient, [O Muḥammad], over what they say and exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
verses.translation: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration [i.e., prayer].

verses.arabic: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
verses.translation: And listen on the Day when the Caller[1532] will call out from a place that is near -
verses.footnotes: [1532]- An angel who will call out Allāh's command for the Resurrection.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
verses.translation: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.translation: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ
verses.translation: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular

verses.arabic: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
verses.translation: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant.[1533] But remind by the Qur’ān whoever fears My threat.
verses.footnotes: [1533]- Forcing people to belief or submission.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
